info.title: AgentXM Registry API
info.description: Registry API for profiles, extensions, and publishing.

200.description: Registry service metadata including health status and documentation entry points.

get.description: Returns service metadata and documentation entrypoints when docs are enabled.

200.description: Response from the OAuth device authorization endpoint (RFC 8628).

allOf.description: OAuth public client identifier.

anyOf.description: Optional space-delimited registry scopes requested by the client.

200.description: OAuth 2.0 token response containing an access/refresh token pair.

post.summary: Exchange OAuth grant for access token

anyOf.description: Authorization code returned to the loopback callback.
PKCE verifier generated by the CLI.

allOf.description: OAuth client identifier.

anyOf.description: Loopback redirect URI the authorization code was bound to.
The device verification code received from the /device/code endpoint.
Refresh token to exchange for a new token pair.
Optional requested scope for refresh-token exchange.

allOf.description: The refresh token to exchange for a new token pair.

anyOf.description: OAuth client identifier.

allOf.description: The access token or refresh token to revoke. Revocation is idempotent.

anyOf.description: Optional RFC 7009 token type hint. Revocation remains non-enumerating.

200.description: Minimal identity response for login checks and CLI whoami.
Your user profile, organizations, and token details.

anyOf.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response for pagination.
Maximum number of tokens to return (1–100, default 50).

200.description: A page of your access tokens.

201.description: Your new access token. The token value is only shown once — save it now.

delete.description: Revokes the access token identified by tokenId.

200.description: Minimal owner summary for machine clients.

get.description: Returns the minimal public owner summary for the provided handle.

post.description: Creates a new team in the organization. Only organization owners and admins may create teams.

get.description: Paginated list of teams. Non-members of the organization receive 404 (hidden existence).
Returns the team when the caller is an organization member or a team member. Non-visible teams surface as 404 (hidden existence).

patch.description: Partial update to a team's displayName and/or description. Only organization owners and admins may update teams.

delete.description: Deletes a team. Memberships and team extension grants cascade. Only organization owners and admins may delete teams.

post.description: Adds a user to a team. Target user must already belong to the team's organization; otherwise returns 422. Only team admins or organization owners/admins may add members.
post.summary: Add a member to a team

get.description: Paginated list of team members. Non-visible teams surface as 404 (hidden existence).

patch.description: Updates a team member's role. Only team admins or organization owners/admins may change roles.

delete.description: Removes a user from a team. Only team admins or organization owners/admins may remove members.
delete.summary: Remove a member from a team

put.description: Adds or updates the collaborator identified by userId on the extension.

delete.description: Removes the collaborator identified by userId from the extension.

post.description: Creates or updates a grant of a team's access to this extension. The team must belong to the same organization that owns the extension (otherwise 422). Only team admins or organization owners/admins may grant.

put.description: Adds or updates the user grant identified by userId on the extension.
put.summary: Add or update a user extension grant

delete.description: Removes the user grant identified by userId from the extension.

put.description: Adds or updates the team grant identified by teamId on the extension.
put.summary: Add or update a team extension grant

delete.description: Removes the team grant identified by teamId from the extension.
Removes a team's grant on this extension. Idempotent — deleting a non-existent grant still returns 204.

get.description: Returns the apex maintainer for an extension, or none when org-owner fallback is active.

put.description: Sets or transfers the apex maintainer for an extension to an eligible user or team.

delete.description: Clears the extension maintainer so org-owner fallback is the only admin path.

post.description: Persists submitted package metadata and resolves package and extension attestations.

get.description: Returns pass/fail status. Public, no auth required.
Returns IETF health+json response with per-dependency check results. Requires X-Health-Key header.
get.summary: Deep health check with dependency status

get.description: Exercises observability pipelines and can simulate server error scenarios. Requires X-Health-Key header.

schema.description: Search query string. Use an empty string to list the public catalog.

anyOf.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response for pagination.
Maximum number of results to return (1–100, default 20).

200.description: A page of extensions matching the search query.

get.description: Returns extensions whose name matches the query, ordered by most recently published version. When `q` is empty, returns the public catalog. Only public, available, non-yanked versions are returned.

anyOf.description: Path to the interactive API documentation, or null when docs are disabled.
Path to the OpenAPI specification, or null when docs are disabled.
